unit_pptx_name: Shark Tank - Grade 5 Sessions and Shark Tank Day (Weeks 5-10).pptx
anchor: Find a problem. Upcycle a fix. Pitch it. Grade 5 teams invent an upcycled product, build a prototype and pitch it; the Grade 6s are the sharks who invest tokens, never buy, on Shark Tank Day, Monday 7 December. Model business all term: Pocket Pal, a hanging pocket sewn from old jeans.

lessons.title: The Business Plan
lessons.focus: Week 5, Grade 5 only, 15 minutes explicit and 40 team time. Natural, human and capital resources on Pocket Pal; teams write the business plan. Critical feature: upcycling saves natural resources.

lessons.title: Build It
lessons.focus: Week 6. Prototype, build-test-fix and choosing a join; first build. Critical feature: when a test fails, fix the part that failed, not the idea.

lessons.title: Brand It
lessons.focus: Week 7. The 4 Ps and taglines; finish the build and start the poster. Critical feature: a tagline is short, catchy and says what the product does for you.

lessons.title: Pitch It
lessons.focus: Week 8. The six-part pitch recipe; teams write and rehearse a 60 to 90 second pitch. Critical feature: the ask is for investment, never a sale.

lessons.title: Dress Rehearsal
lessons.focus: Week 9. Kind, specific, helpful feedback and the Shark Scorecard; rehearsal swaps and one fix. Critical feature: fix the exact part the feedback names.

lessons.title: Shark Tank Day
lessons.focus: Monday 7 December, Week 10. Run sheet, Grade 6 shark briefing, pitches, stall walk with tokens, winner. An event deck, not a lesson.
